# Frontier source-model controls

`density-controls.json` records 151 float32-rounded synthetic AP1 inputs, independently calculated formed codes and AP1, and OCIO sRGB/Display P3 outputs. NumPy formation and separable interpolation use the black-anchored calibration and endpoint-preserving source volumes. Inputs cover black, grey, signed/HDR light, neutral exposure, moderate colours and near-black rays. Historical knot-approach inputs remain held-out controls, not current knot-location invariants. Provenance records calibration and source-volume hashes; no photographs or original software files are included.

`negative-controls.json` covers 49 synthetic inputs across all 16 colour stocks. It records independent fixed-exposure dye coefficients and base-relative scanner optical densities, exact-scene-grey OD, formed codes and AP1 outputs. NumPy applies grey balance, the shared zero-origin 515-code/OD matrix/gains and B's pre-continuation +62 translation, then samples the gamma-authored 65³ AP1 responses by separable interpolation. Calibration and response hashes identify these expectations. Final 65³ identities check artifact reproducibility, not physical accuracy. The [negative-entry tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/negative/tests.rs) also check linear mapping, base-flux normalization, cancellation and source-mode placement.

[Source tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/tests.rs) compare preparation with the independent controls and check source-volume addressing, shared LUT vertices and quantized black. [Formation tests](../../../src/looks/frontier/formation/tests.rs) protect neutral preservation and B's pre-continuation translation. These are not exact off-grid expectations for the final creative cube.

`legacy-none-{a,b}.json` retain 27 corner/midpoint samples of captured pedestal-based None LUTs; `legacy-portra-{a,b}.json` retain the corresponding samples of the affine selected-stock calibration. These compact 3³ assets test [saved-project authority](../../look_project.rs), not rendering approximation quality: known catalogue labels reopen those exact numbers rather than preparing the current calibration.

[Composition tests](../../../src/gpu/photograph/output_tests.rs) compare the prepared LUT's GPU execution with its scalar interpolation plus OCIO output for both targets. Shared analytic LUT fixtures test interpolation independently, including an unregistered provider's numeric content. Other composition cases cover sample flags, covered failure admission and immutable resource leases. [EXR export tests](../../../src/gpu_export/job/tests/starting_exposure.rs) verify scene bypass with an active look. [Preparation](../../../src/looks/authoring.rs) and [storage](../../../src/looks/storage.rs) tests protect source-independent reopening and exact sample bits. Composed editor cases exercise nondefault grading, selection, history, TIFF export and reopening.
